Container.Name: MediaOps
Container.Overview: MediaOps is a self-hosted, single-tenant Discord automation platform for media-server communities. Each operator creates their own Discord application/bot and connects this container to their own Emby, Ombi and Watch Party services.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: discord emby ombi watch party media server homelab automation
Container.Requires: Create your own Discord application/bot first (see docs/DISCORD_BOT_SETUP.md), plus outbound Internet access for Discord and network access to your configured Emby, Ombi and Watch Party services. V1 is not a universal hosted multi-tenant bot.

Config.Name: MediaOps Data
Config.Description: Persistent MediaOps runtime data and scheduled Watch Party state.

Config.Name: Bot Display Name
Config.Description: Public-facing bot name used by MediaOps panels and messages. This does not rename your Discord application itself.

Config.Name: Media Server Display Name
Config.Description: Friendly media-server/community name used in public MediaOps panels.

Config.Name: Demo Mode
Config.Description: Set true for public/demo deployments. MediaOps keeps Watch Party controls visible but disables join links so configured Watch Party URLs are never emitted into Discord.

Config.Name: Media Provider
Config.Description: Media provider backend. Emby is currently supported.

Config.Name: Discord Token
Config.Description: Secret token for the Discord bot/application you created for this MediaOps deployment.

Config.Name: Discord Client ID
Config.Description: Application/client ID for your Discord application.

Config.Name: Discord Guild ID
Config.Description: Discord server/guild ID for this self-hosted deployment and guild-scoped command registration.

Config.Name: Emby URL
Config.Description: Emby base URL reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Emby API Key
Config.Description: Emby API key used by MediaOps.

Config.Name: Request Provider
Config.Description: Optional request backend. Use ombi to enable /request after configuring Ombi URL and API key.

Config.Name: Ombi URL
Config.Description: Ombi base URL reachable from MediaOps. Required when REQUEST_PROVIDER=ombi.

Config.Name: Ombi API Key
Config.Description: Ombi API key used to search and create requests. Required when REQUEST_PROVIDER=ombi.

Config.Name: Ombi Auto Approve
Config.Description: true automatically approves newly created requests; false leaves them pending for an Ombi administrator.

Config.Name: Media Requests Forum ID
Config.Description: Optional Discord Forum channel used for Ombi request lifecycle synchronization.

Config.Name: Media Requests Webhook ID
Config.Description: Exact Discord webhook ID allowed to drive Forum status changes. This is an ID, not the secret webhook URL/token.

Config.Name: Requested Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID for newly submitted requests.

Config.Name: Processing Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID for approved/in-process requests.

Config.Name: Available Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum terminal tag ID for available media.

Config.Name: Failed Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum terminal tag ID for failed processing/acquisition.

Config.Name: Denied Status Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum terminal tag ID for denied/rejected requests.

Config.Name: Movie Media Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying movie requests.

Config.Name: Series Media Tag ID
Config.Description: Discord Forum tag ID identifying TV-series requests.

Config.Name: Watch Party URL
Config.Description: Public URL of the Watch Party service. Demo Mode prevents this URL from being emitted into Discord.

Config.Name: Watch Party Internal URL
Config.Description: Optional LAN/internal Watch Party URL used by MediaOps API calls.

Config.Name: Watch Party Emby User
Config.Description: Dedicated non-admin Emby account used to create and host Watch Parties.

Config.Name: Watch Party Emby Password
Config.Description: Password for the dedicated Watch Party Emby account.

Config.Name: Watch Party Retention Days
Config.Description: Days to keep completed/cancelled Watch Party history.

Config.Name: MediaOps Locale
Config.Description: Default language for automated messages. Supported: en or fr.

Config.Name: MediaOps Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for Watch Party scheduling input without an explicit offset.

Config.Name: MediaOps Data Directory
Config.Description: Container path for persistent runtime data.
